title: BPI names Ginbee Go to succeed Limcaoco as CEO

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) has tapped consumer banking head Maria Cristina “Ginbee” Go to succeed Jose Teodoro “TG” Limcaoco as president and CEO next year. On Thursday, the Ayala-led bank said its board approved a succession plan for Go to assume the posts on April 26, 2027, following its annual stockholders’ meeting and subject to necessary approvals.
